# Pull Request

## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New icons (adding new icons to the library)
- [ ] Enhancement (improving existing icons or functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

## New Icons Checklist

If you're adding new icons, please ensure:

- [ ] Icons follow the 24x24 viewBox standard
- [ ] Icons use 2px stroke width (or are filled variants)
- [ ] Icons have been optimized with SVGO
- [ ] Icons are named in kebab-case (e.g., `my-icon.svg`)
- [ ] Icons have been tested at multiple sizes
- [ ] Icons have been added to the appropriate category in ICONS.md

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have run `pnpm run build` successfully
- [ ] I have run `pnpm run typecheck` successfully
- [ ] I have run `pnpm run lint` successfully

## Screenshots (if applicable)

Add screenshots to help explain your changes.
